title: Concept: Framework SQL built from input (djangoextra) — review required
description: In djangoextra, qs.extra(where=["x=%s" % v]) mixes SQL text with values. ORM and helper layers pass interpolated text straight to the driver. The remedy is bound parameters via filter() expressions.
applicability: djangoextra data calls; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Full database compromise when untrusted input reaches the query; HIGH severity.
